offence_note: Fentanyl/meth trafficking, loaded prohibited firearm, failure to attend court
sentence_quote: Hence, I am imposing an effective overall sentence of 36 months.
systemic_quote: I accept that systematic and background factors played a role in bringing her before the court today and may have a mitigating effect on her moral blameworthiness.
note: 36 months concurrent plus 15 days consecutive for failure to attend; conditional sentence rejected.

offence_note: Two breaches of probation (returning to St. Ann's Academy)
sentence_quote: I order that the sentences of July 6, 2006, be varied as follows: the 90-day sentence to 45 days imprisonment and the 120-day sentence to 60 days imprisonment.
note: Consecutive 90 and 120 days varied to concurrent 45 and 60 days.

offence_note: Sexual assaults, threats and extortion against son's girlfriend
sentence_quote: the appeal is allowed and the sentence varied to fifteen months imprisonment to commence on the day the respondent surrenders into custody.
note: Conditional sentence replaced by 15 months custody; fit sentence would have been five years.

offence_note: Returning after deportation and misrepresentation under IRPA
sentence_quote: a just and appropriate sentence for Mr. Lazar, in all the circumstances of this case, should be 4½ months of imprisonment, less presentence custody.
note: 1.5 months and 4.5 months concurrent; other mitigation was consent to removal.

offence_note: Administering drug to confine; criminal negligence causing bodily harm
sentence_quote: This is an appeal from two six year concurrent sentences of imprisonment
note: Leave granted, appeal dismissed; eight months pre-sentence custody noted.

offence_note: Possession of MDMA and GHB for trafficking (dial-a-dope)
sentence_quote: on Counts 1 and 3 of the indictment I hereby impose concurrent suspended sentences.
note: Suspended sentence with 12 month curfew; DNA, s.109 and forfeiture orders made earlier and confirmed.

sentence_quote: I am of the view that a fit sentence is 5 years from this date forward.
note: 5 years from sentencing date after allowing almost one year pre-sentence custody; total before credit not stated.

offence_note: Sexual assault, sexual interference of child; breach of bail; soliciting
sentence_quote: and fixed a sentence of 20 months on those charges, taking into account the two months the accused had already served.
note: 20 months stated after allowing two months already served.

offence_note: Three shoplifting offences while on probation
sentence_quote: the sentencing judge imposed a nine-month conditional sentence with a 4 p.m. to 7 a.m. curfew, and a probationary term of one year with counselling.
note: Summary conviction appeal dismissed; mitigating factor was doing well on a conditional sentence.

offence_note: Second degree murder and manslaughter with firearm
sentence_quote: On the offence of second degree murder in the killing of Ms. Howe, I sentence you to life in prison, and I set the period of parole ineligibility at 13 years.
note: Eight years concurrent for manslaughter (joint recommendation); victim surcharge waived.
